statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail is below the block threshold after a partial rebound from the session low, while the delayed downside path and semiconductor weakness keep residual Friday-close risk elevated.
recommendation: The mapped state reflects residual path risk through the remaining Friday futures window; escalation would require renewed near-low holding, shallow or failed rebounds and broader cross-asset alignment.
headline: Partial rebound lowers Tail to WATCH while chip weakness keeps Stress extreme
body: At the assessment cutoff, the latest available delayed NQ quote was 29,494.25, down 0.68%, at 15:25:58 ET and about 58 points above the session low. Later market reporting showed the Nasdaq down about 0.6% and the 2-year Treasury yield near 4.35%, while Cboe VIX was 14.67. This is stressed but not a fully aligned no-retracement path.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail was mostly low-to-watch while Stress rose into the extreme band around Jackson Hole. Tail reached 27% at 17:00 UTC as a delayed downside leg emerged, eased to 22% at 18:00 UTC, and returned to 25% during the 19:00 UTC power-hour assessment.
outlookSummary: Risk is concentrated in the remaining Friday NQ futures window through the scheduled weekly close at 21:00 UTC. A renewed one-way extension with failed rebounds would preserve higher Tail; otherwise live path risk should fall sharply after the close, leaving weekend headline and reopening-gap risk as the main residual channels.

forecast.analysis: Latest available delayed NQ was 29,494.25 (-0.68%) at 15:25:58 ET, about 58 points above the session low after the delayed downside leg. Broad chip weakness and firmer yields keep Stress extreme, but VIX near 14.7 and mixed megacaps keep Tail at WATCH rather than a block.
